_doc: The turn loop as data (A3), restructured to the BYTE-VERIFIED per-power interleave (turn_dispatch.md 3, func_005760): King -> Orders(+REF accrual @0x24B42, +AI @0x24731) -> Production(+immigration @0x2F218) -> Diplomacy -> Periodic run per power 0..3 in that order, then the global tail (market once per turn -- the EXE nests drift in each power's production slice @0x363D3, but the validated drift folds all four powers' volumes in one decay step; a model-shape note -- then shore fire, the fog sweep and the year/season cadence @0x5A9D). phases with scope 'power' run inside the power loop in list order; scope 'global' after it. King/Diplomacy/Periodic have no sim body (king dialogs, king-tax dispatch and the Congress live in the event layer). A golden-master test asserts this pipeline == sim::step_turn.

phases.note: Per power: REF accrual+purchase (crown-facing power), the AI strategic pass (computer powers), then that power's standing orders. Shore fire + the fog sweep run once after the whole power loop.
The per-power colony loop (func_02F052 @0x2F25F): production, SoL, build, growth, school.
Rides the production slice (func_0363A2 @0x363E2): the power's Europe dock advances.
Supply-accumulator drift + republish + volume reset, once per turn (model-shape note in _doc).
Turn counter +1 (@0x5A9D); 1 turn = 1 year before 1600, Spring/Autumn halves after.
